# Plugin.Maui.AppReview

iOS SKStoreReviewController plus open the store listing. Android Play Core ReviewManager on Play-installed builds.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.AppReview
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.AppReview
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-app-review/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Current release

1.1.0. Android `RequestAsync` uses Play Core `ReviewManager` on Play-installed builds. Sideload / emulator / missing Play returns `Unavailable` — call `OpenStoreListingAsync`. Host apps must declare Android and iOS permissions listed in the README.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.AppReview

Registration: `UseAppReview` — see README.md.

```csharp
var outcome = await AppReview.Current.RequestAsync();
if (outcome.Kind is AppReviewKind.Unavailable or AppReviewKind.NotSupported)
    await AppReview.Current.OpenStoreListingAsync();
```

`GetEligibilityAsync` is local Preferences (launches, days, cooldown). `Shown` means the OS was asked, not that the user rated. Do not label the only path “Rate us”.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I prompt a Play / App Store review from MAUI?
- Open the store listing
- Launch / day / cooldown eligibility

## Do not use when

- Binary in-app updates (use Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate)
- Ratings stored on your server
